plan.title: SRC-SCH-002 — Start now, end after 30 minutes

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX capability required for event creation.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and keep Publish available.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title for publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Verify that the RFQ template was applied.
Add the CYLINDER product and set the requested quantity to 10.
Choose the required delivery location for the line item.
Verify that the selected delivery location is shown in the sheet.
Add one QA test vendor to satisfy the participant requirement.
Keep the start at now, choose the 30-minute duration, inspect the calculated end, and save the schedule.
Verify that the saved schedule chip shows the configured 30-minute duration.
Publish the configured RFQ and confirm the publication dialog.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Verify that the published Project Details screen exposes the bidding end time.
Verify that the published event still shows the 30-minute schedule.
